scope: Bounded first production set; every catalog row is a design entry, including coverage work for existing definitions. Existing-definition does not mean final item art exists. No new runtime content, grants, prices or build timers are introduced. Entry region_ids are first proposed availability/location, not a phase-wide union or a limit on where owned portable items may later be carried.
identity_policy: Catalog IDs index design; runtime_ref preserves current IDs. Do not rename or convert durable scrap/timber/supplies or item instances from this file. Null recipe amounts/durations are unresolved and must never execute.

first-woodland.scope_note: IH2-053 selects traversable trail, timed bridge/opening and cosmetic discovery using the existing three resources and two recipes. New wood distinctions, material/tool definitions and recipes in this semantic phase are later unassigned candidates after integrated IH2-050 acceptance; their presence here does not add them to053.

art_policy.license: Original authored art first; independently verified CC0 alternatives only. No paid assets or imported game cast.
rules: Inventory icon, world form and directional/equipped/build/grow/damage states are distinct obligations.
Generic PROPS.art hints and procedural drawings are not final item-specific inventory/world production families.
Opening, damage and corpse poses present confirmed server state; no animation grants output or determines damage.
Housing and furnishings are protected from prank/combat destruction; no damage-state mechanic is implied for homes.
